name: IC RF — SPI, 3.6V — QFN
description: Surface-mount RF IC cluster featuring SPI communication, 3.6V operation, and QFN package footprints such as QFN-32-1EP_5x5mm_P0.5mm_EP3.3x3.3mm.
selection_hints: Select for surface-mount RF IC applications operating at 3.6V with an SPI interface.
Verify compatibility with QFN package footprint QFN-32-1EP_5x5mm_P0.5mm_EP3.3x3.3mm.
Choose when requiring Tier A rated parts such as AT86RF233-Z.
avoid_when: Do not use if the design requires through-hole mounting instead of surface mount.
Avoid when the application requires interfaces other than SPI or voltages other than 3.6V.
Avoid if the PCB layout cannot accommodate QFN package footprints.
